comportamentos: Admission process with an application form and two phases, homologation and evaluation: present, but the application form only has name, email and 'Solicita bolsa', whereas the official fix exposes the full Sucupira/SISPOS field set (sispos_sucupira_student_fields_config) for reuse

Homologation form with 'Optante negro ou indígena', 'PcD', 'Homologação' and 'Razão de indeferimento', plus a consolidation email and the approval condition Homologação = Deferida: present, if the assumed model constants exist

Evaluation form with the two grades and 'Observação', a consolidation computing the averages and 'Nota final', and the approval condition Nota final >= 6: present, but it relies on unverified constants such as FormCondition::GE, FormField::CODE and a Liquid 'avg' filter

Committees made of a secretary user (falling back to admin) for homologation and admin for evaluation: present, but it depends on unverified APIs such as User.secretary, committee.members and AdmissionPhaseCommittee
Default ranking with the 'Ampla concorrência', 'Racial' and 'PcD' selectors, and a scholarship ranking conditioned on the scholarship request: present, with unverified model names and attributes
Restructuring of the seeds / reuse of the controller field configuration in the default example: missing (the candidate uses an isolated migration instead of the official seeds approach)
justificativa: The candidate builds the example in a standalone migration with a reduced application form and many model names and constants that cannot be confirmed, while the official fix reorganizes the seeds and reuses the full Sucupira field configuration, so the observable equivalence is doubtful.
